summary: De L'Europe Amsterdam is luxury hotel in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, founded in 1896. Type: private company. About 155 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Family-owned luxury hotel in central Amsterdam since 1896, with a two-Michelin-star restaurant; offers English-language hospitality internships.

culture.text: About 155 staff, many from Hotelschool The Hague, ROC van Amsterdam, Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences and Stenden.
Includes two-Michelin-star Flore, Brasserie Marie, Trattoria Graziella, bars, a wellness centre and a concept store, all under one roof.
Trainees support Rooms, F&B and management in a place where top-level service is central.

open.text: Not an IND recognised visa sponsor, so non-EU graduates may struggle to get a work visa here.
All 3 current jobs here are Amsterdam internships that don't require Dutch, averaging about 78 LinkedIn applicants each.

worth_knowing.text: Was awarded three MICHELIN Keys, per the headline.
Named best hotel in the Benelux again, per the headline.
